runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: I need the observable failure case to distinguish duplicate terminal writes from duplicate frame construction.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requests a bounded fix for duplicate terminal repaint output, limited to the CLI composer implementation and its tests. Other files must not be changed. The requested validation is `bun test` when appropriate. The unresolved point is the exact visible duplication and the definition of the single authoritative frame.

refinedBrief.goal: Eliminate duplicate terminal repaint output while preserving exactly one authoritative rendered frame.
deliverables: Update `packages/cli/src/composer.ts` only as needed to correct repaint behavior.
Add or update focused coverage in `packages/cli/src/composer.test.ts`.
constraints: Do not modify `.env`, `.git/**`, `bun.lock`, or any other file.
acceptanceCriteria: The reported duplicate repaint behavior is no longer observable in the confirmed scenario.
Tests cover the corrected repaint behavior.
The permitted test command succeeds, if execution is appropriate.
nonGoals: Do not refactor unrelated terminal rendering behavior.
Do not modify files outside the two allowed writer paths.
Do not change terminal output semantics beyond resolving the confirmed duplication.

questions.prompt: What is the observable duplicate repaint failure that must be fixed?
questions.rationale: This determines whether the change should target repeated output writes, repeated frame construction, or an incorrect terminal refresh sequence.

options.label: Same frame twice
options.description: The identical terminal frame is visibly emitted twice for one update.

options.label: Old and new frames
options.description: A stale frame and the current frame are both emitted during one repaint.

options.label: Existing test failure
options.description: The expected behavior is already captured by a failing test or assertion.
